scripts.dev: npm run build -w @stacked/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stacked/shared && npm run build -w @stacked/web && npm run build -w @stacked/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stacked/shared && npm run typecheck -w @stacked/server && npm run typecheck -w @stacked/web
